note: Gin Gutenberg is a presentation-only glue module (no config object, no permissions, no Drush, no plugins, configure=null). It depends on the gutenberg module and activates via hooks when (a) Gutenberg full editing is on for a node type -- gutenberg.settings:<type>_enable_full == TRUE, read by _gin_gutenberg_is_gutenberg_enabled() -- and (b) a Gin/Claro theme is active with the 'use gutenberg' permission (_gin_gutenberg_gin_is_active()). It adds the gutenberg--enabled html class, attaches library gin_gutenberg/gin_gutenberg, and registers/suggests templates page__node__edit__gutenberg and page__node__add__gutenberg, and moves status/moderation_state into Gutenberg's meta sidebar. Since the module has no config of its own, medium/hard cases are grounded in the gutenberg.settings:<type>_enable_full flag that drives the integration's activation; setup/reset/cleanup only touch the article_enable_full / page_enable_full keys and clear them to restore baseline.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal gin_gutenberg module do, and what module does it require to work?
evals.expected_output: It is a presentation/theming integration that makes the Gutenberg block editor render correctly inside the Gin (or Claro) admin theme on node add/edit forms. It requires (depends on) the gutenberg module. It has no configuration of its own.

evals.prompt: There is no settings page for gin_gutenberg. How do I get the Gin-styled Gutenberg editor to actually appear for a content type on my Drupal site?
evals.expected_output: gin_gutenberg has no config; it activates via hooks. Enable the gutenberg + gin_gutenberg modules, set the admin theme to Gin (or Claro), turn on the Gutenberg experience for the content type (which sets gutenberg.settings:<type>_enable_full = TRUE), and grant the role the 'use gutenberg' permission. Then its hooks fire on that type's node forms.

evals.prompt: On a Gutenberg-enabled node form, what does gin_gutenberg add at the theme layer? Name the CSS/library, the html class, and the page templates it provides.
evals.expected_output: It adds the gutenberg--enabled class to the <html> element, attaches the gin_gutenberg/gin_gutenberg library (dist/gin_gutenberg.css + .js), and registers/suggests the page templates page__node__edit__gutenberg and page__node__add__gutenberg. It also moves the Published/status and moderation_state controls into Gutenberg's meta sidebar.

evals.prompt: gin_gutenberg only styles the editor for content types that have the Gutenberg full-editing experience turned on. On this site, inspect the Gutenberg configuration and state which content type has full Gutenberg editing enabled (the type gin_gutenberg would activate on).
evals.expected_output: gutenberg.settings:article_enable_full is TRUE, so the Article content type has full Gutenberg editing enabled and gin_gutenberg activates on its node forms.

evals.prompt: On this site, of the two content types Article and Basic page, exactly one has the Gutenberg full-editing experience enabled. Inspect the live Gutenberg configuration and state which content type it is (i.e. where gin_gutenberg's styling applies).
evals.expected_output: gutenberg.settings:page_enable_full is TRUE while article_enable_full is not, so the Basic page (page) type has full Gutenberg editing enabled.

evals.prompt: So that gin_gutenberg styles the editor for Articles, turn on the full Gutenberg editing experience for the Article content type on this site and apply the change live.
evals.expected_output: Set gutenberg.settings:article_enable_full to TRUE (via the Article content type's edit form 'Enable Gutenberg experience' option or by saving the config), then save. This is the flag gin_gutenberg reads to activate.

evals.prompt: I want the fancy block editor (Gutenberg, styled by Gin Gutenberg) to show up when editing Basic pages on my site. Set that up on the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the Gutenberg experience for the Basic page (page) content type, i.e. set gutenberg.settings:page_enable_full to TRUE and save. gin_gutenberg then activates on page node forms.
